already_have: Controllers already have Business Central Premium, Entra, and two-person journal SOD.
door: Generate a proof-day brief a controller can forward. Do not invent a contact inbox.

icp.ai: Client Copilot / agents / BYO models — not AINav
icp.control: existing two-person journal SOD; AINav dual admit is the human-control failsafe for client AI and counterparty AI
icp.counterparty_ai: The client's customers' AI drafting into the client's SoR — not a seat
icp.institutes_ainav: Client institutes L1 and the stable of desks, keep, and hours as the failsafe for their AI and their customers' AI

incident: The unauthorized general-journal post the client's AI or the client's customer AI drafted and two humans did not admit. Every new client AI is another such surface. L1 is the week you prove one human plane sits over all of them: no admit, no write. The client institutes AINav as the failsafe, not as the AI.

must_have_for.board: Fiduciary oversight of material AI write risk. Inventory of models is not a control. One admit plane plus second-record keep is.
must_have_for.examiner: First record is the SoR write. Second record is who admitted it. Off-switch evidence is that the plane can freeze. Not a filing.
must_have_for.owner: The controller who cannot let any AI post a journal without two seats, and who must be able to freeze writes without turning the business off.

no_means.fail_closed: If either person is missing, or the apply fails, the write does not land and there is no fake success.
no_means.off_switch: Fail-closed. No dual admit, no write. Humans freeze new grants. Inference may continue. Consequence does not.
no_means.refuse: Refusing is the product working. No grant. No SoR write.

sale: The sale is the ninety-minute proof.
